title: SMS template reading grade and segment fit
notes: Renders every SMS template builder in src/lib/nudges/sms-policy-shared.ts (buildWeeklyJobsSms, buildInterviewConfirmSms, buildInterviewDeclineAckSms, buildHeardBackSms, buildRetentionSms, buildNotificationSms) against every realistic value in the fixture (long employer names, long job titles) and scores each rendered body with the same Flesch-Kincaid scorer used everywhere else (src/lib/sage/readability.ts). max_grade is the raw FK grade (not the >=12-word `scorable` gate — SMS bodies are short by design and the noisy-short-text carve-out would exempt exactly the strings this benchmark exists to check). over_160_gsm7 counts renders that either exceed SMS_MAX_LENGTH (composeSmsBody throws SmsBodyTooLongError) or contain a character outside the real GSM7_BASIC set (exported from sms-policy-shared.ts for this purpose) — either one means the message would silently split into two paid segments or truncate on some carriers. TIER IS WATCH, NOT GATE, pending an owner call (2026-09-05, builder A8): first measurement is max_grade=8.3 (buildHeardBackSms with 'Customer Service Representative - Bilingual Preferred'), above the floor=6 the design/plan specify. This is not a fixable copy bug — the grade is driven by the verbatim job title text, which the message must carry — so either the floor needs an owner-authorized exception for templates that interpolate a real job title, or the template needs a design rethink (e.g. dropping the title from the SMS and pointing at the app instead). over_160_gsm7 is clean (0) on the same run and would be gate-ready on its own. Do not silently loosen the floor to make this pass — report the real number and let Britt decide, same as the touch-targets suite's pattern for a measured-but-unresolved breach.
